name: Immutable evidence ledger with two views
law: A model may choose what to use, but it may not decide what ceases to exist.

ordinary_code_checks: reply_to binds the capsule to the exact question
the evidence exists at the declared source version and coordinates
permission allows the fragment to travel
lineage and content hashes are stored without counting copies as independent

best_answer.purpose: Show the best-supported cause or explicit uncertainty and the safe action or next measurement.

all_versions.purpose: Preserve every same-case claim, competing view, conditional rule, source, and lineage.

visible_shelves.meaning: A competing or mistaken view about the same observed case.
Becomes actionable when another accepted fragment supports its condition.
May relate to the case, but the relationship is not established yet.
Probably belongs to another case; hidden by default but preserved for audit.

lineage_rule: Ten copies from one lineage are one dependent view, not ten independent confirmations.

answer_contract.main_view: State the best-supported answer and cite its own evidence.
answer_contract.alternative_view: State relevant alternatives, their support, conflicts, and lineage dependence without citing the main view as evidence for them.
answer_contract.missing_information: State only missing information explicitly supplied by an accepted capsule or use the fixed no-information response.
answer_contract.citations: Every factual view must cite evidence from its own shelf.

evidence.gate_15c: Pairwise Qwen3-8B rejected every clearly foreign fragment in manual review but retained eighteen same-case copied reports.
evidence.gate_15d: Whole-bundle Qwen3-8B retained all sixty required cause/action pieces and zero of 396 frozen irrelevant fragments, but discarded all twenty-four same-case alternatives.
evidence.combined_design_reason: The two views solve different jobs. Best-answer optimization must not control evidence preservation.

not_yet_proven: The union can recover all twenty-four same-case alternatives without exposing foreign records on unseen questions.
Lineage grouping remains correct at network scale.
A final writer can use both shelves without mixing their citations or inventing facts.
The policy works outside the synthetic English world.

next_gate.name: Build the two shelves from preserved Gate 15C and 15D traces
next_gate.goal: Recover all sixty required pieces and all twenty-four same-case alternatives, keep all 396 other fragments auditable but hidden by default, and collapse dependent copies by lineage.
